title: manulea altissima subsp. glabricaulis
intro: Manulea altissima subsp. glabricaulis, commonly known as a subspecies of the Manulea altissima plant, is a flowering plant in the family Scrophulariaceae. Manulea altissima subsp. glabricaulis is a medicinal plant that has been traditionally used for its health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antiseptic properties. The plant is known to exhibit therapeutic actions such as wound healing, antimicrobial activity, and antioxidant effects, attributed to its bioactive constituents including flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids. These bioactive constituents may contribute to its use in traditional medicine for the treatment of various ailments, although further research is needed to confirm its efficacy and safety.
